name: How long does it take to complete common home repairs?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete common home repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of home repairs depends heavily on their complexity. Simple fixes like a running toilet or a faulty light switch can often be completed within an hour or two. More involved tasks, such as significant drywall patching or repairing a damaged door frame, might take half a day to a full day. Larger projects like water damage remediation can extend over several days. We provide an estimated timeline with our project quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary: simple fixes take 1-2 hours, while more complex jobs can take half a day to several days. We provide timelines with quotes.
